description: This file defines the LocalizationDao class, which handles data access operations related to localization features such as languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for searching, counting, retrieving, saving, and deleting localization entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: LocalizationDao
classes.description: A data access object (DAO) class responsible for managing localization data such as languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups within the HRM system, using Doctrine ORM for database operations.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages based on specified search filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NLanguagePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for listing languages with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of languages matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Checks which language IDs already exist in the database.

methods.name: saveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Stores a new or updated language entity.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves translation strings with their normalized form for a specified language.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslationsForExport
methods.description: Retrieves translation strings formatted for export purposes.

methods.name: getTranslationsQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with filters for translation strings based on search parameters.

methods.name: getTranslationsCount
methods.description: Counts translation strings matching certain filters.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedLangString
methods.description: Saves or updates multiple translation string entities.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStrings
methods.description: Persists import error records related to language strings.

methods.name: getImportErrorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of import error records based on filters.

methods.name: getImportErrorCount
methods.description: Counts import error records matching criteria.

methods.name: getImportErrorQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query wrapper for fetching import errors based on filters.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes import error records associated with specific language strings.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLanguageAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes import errors for a specific language and employee number.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for localization groups based on search filters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for listing localization groups.

methods.name: getI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Counts localization groups based on filters.

methods.name: deleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Marks language entries as removed.

methods.name: getLangStringById
methods.description: Retrieves a language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds a language string based on its unit and group IDs.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Fetches an I18N error entity by its name.

methods.name: getI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18N group entity by its name.
